notes.title: Patch V1.1.003
notes.content:
Main change: Based on feedback from various players, we decided to go through and streamline dialogue and cutscenes to provide a better experience for new users and get them into the game faster. We feel this change still retains the goofy humor we were hoping to convey through the story without letting the lore of the world get in the way of players who want to just jump in and explore.

Other Fixes:
- Added a "press to exit" UI prompt when getting onto the ferris wheel.
- Fixed a drink duplicate bug in the Last Resort level.
- Increased the par time for all Drinkvestigate game modes to make them a bit more attainable.
